title: 管理員審核 API (後端)
acceptance: GET /api/admin/enrolments?status=PENDING_VERIFICATION&page=1 — returns paginated enrolments with user + course info
APPROVE sets paymentStatus to VERIFIED, updates receiptNumber with auto-generated sequential number
REJECT sets paymentStatus to REJECTED, stores rejection reason
Admin-only: use middleware role check (only ADMIN role can access)
Payment proof image served via presigned GET URL from S3 (generate temporary download URL)
verification: GET /api/admin/enrolments as ADMIN → returns list with user.nameEn, course.nameEn, paymentStatus. PATCH to approve → paymentStatus=VERIFIED. PATCH to reject → paymentStatus=REJECTED. Non-admin → 403.
